# eon_source_gcp_folder (Resource)

Connects a GCP folder to the Eon project. All GCP projects within the folder (and its sub-folders) will be automatically discovered and available for backup. Projects matching the exclusion patterns will be skipped during discovery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Connect a GCP folder for backup operations
resource "eon_source_gcp_folder" "production" {
  organization_id              = "123456789012"
  folder_id                    = "987654321098"
  management_service_account_id = "eon-sa@my-management-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

# Example: Connect a GCP folder with project exclusion patterns
resource "eon_source_gcp_folder" "production_filtered" {
  organization_id              = "123456789012"
  folder_id                    = "987654321098"
  management_service_account_id = "eon-sa@my-management-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

  exclude_project_patterns = [
    "dev-*",
    "temp-*",
  ]
}

# Output the folder details
output "production_folder" {
  description = "Details of the connected GCP production folder"
  value = {
    id                       = eon_source_gcp_folder.production.id
    name                     = eon_source_gcp_folder.production.name
    state                    = eon_source_gcp_folder.production.state
    management_project_id    = eon_source_gcp_folder.production.management_project_id
    exclude_project_patterns = eon_source_gcp_folder.production_filtered.exclude_project_patterns
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder_id` (String) GCP folder ID.
- `management_service_account_id` (String) Email of the GCP service account used to manage the folder.
- `organization_id` (String) GCP organization ID that contains the folder.

### Optional

- `exclude_project_patterns` (List of String) Glob patterns for GCP project IDs to exclude from discovery (e.g., `["internal-*", "test-*"]`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date and time the GCP folder was connected to the Eon project.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned folder ID.
- `management_project_id` (String) GCP project ID where the management service account resides. Computed from the service account email.
- `name` (String) Display name of the GCP folder in Eon.
- `state` (String) Connection state of the GCP folder. Possible values: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the GCP folder was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import eon_source_gcp_folder.example <eon-folder-id>
```
